# Eddie Bullock

> I am a PhD researcher at the University of Cambridge, work on autonomous vehicles at Minimal, writer read by 58,000+ people, and occasional ultramarathon runner.

## PhD research

I am a PhD student at the University of Cambridge's [Autism Research Centre](https://www.autismresearchcentre.com/people/eddie-bullock/), funded by a Medical Research Council industrial Collaborative Award in Science and Engineering studentship. I work on vision-language models. I am building end-to-end world models that interpret social interaction, and deploying them on wearable glasses at under 100 milliseconds. I also do mechanistic interpretability on how these models represent a social scene. We collaborate closely with AI researchers at Stanford and Harvard.

Publications are available on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=toL9Lq0AAAAJ&hl=en).

- How accurate are LLMs on multimodal theory of mind tasks: https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=toL9Lq0AAAAJ&citation_for_view=toL9Lq0AAAAJ:IjCSPb-OGe4C
- Natural language processing for analysis of electronic health records: https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=toL9Lq0AAAAJ&citation_for_view=toL9Lq0AAAAJ:u-x6o8ySG0sC

I work closely with [Emteq Labs](https://www.emteqlabs.com/) on this project. They make non-invasive human-computer interfaces.

## AI engineering internship at Minimal

I worked on a vision-language-action model for an autonomous delivery robot. I built the pipelines for data collection and training, fine-tuned the model for deployment, collected synthetic data, and developed the simulation environment.

Minimal: https://minimal.tech

The simulation image on the site is a stand-in until real footage is added.

## Writing and science communication

I write about AI and neuroscience for 58,000+ people on [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/eddiebullock.bsky.social) and [Substack](https://substack.com/@edbullock). I run workshops for teachers on AI and [neuroscience in schools across the UK](https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=toL9Lq0AAAAJ&citation_for_view=toL9Lq0AAAAJ:d1gkVwhDpl0C), and I recently delivered them to charities in Kolkata.

I host [Bridging the Gap](https://www.redcapmedia.co.uk/bridging-the-gap), a podcast of interviews with scientists.

## Fun

I am currently [raising money for sarcoma](https://www.justgiving.com/page/eddie-bullock-1).

101km, with 3,000m of elevation, Peak District ultramarathon with Sacha.

800km in 8 days for Alzheimer's. We raised £7,000. Follow the journey: https://www.instagram.com/normandynomads/

I will be running the London Marathon and the Cotswold ultramarathon in 2027.

Oh, and I'm also converting a classic VW T3.
